segments.normalizedSource: ```swift func triggerProgrammaticCapture(device: MTLDevice) { let captureManager = MTLCaptureManager.shared() let captureDescriptor = MTLCaptureDescriptor() captureDescriptor.captureObject = self.device do { try captureManager.startCapture(with: captureDescriptor) } catch { fatalError("error when trying to capture: \(error)") } } func runMetalCommands(commandQueue: MTLCommandQueue) { let commandBuffer = commandQueue.makeCommandBuffer()! // Do Metal work. commandBuffer.commit() let captureManager = MTLCaptureManager.shared() captureManager.stopCapture() } ```
